result.summary: Wrote lit.md for seed 805 / round 2 (C group, 文献员 role), addressing analysis.md's four literature questions (L1 intraday volume timing vs. dispersion/volatility separation; L2 separating call-auction minutes from continuous-session minutes; L3 EMA/multi-day level vs. own-history z-score persistence; L4 nominal price level and float-share count vs. market cap / board / listing age). Used WebSearch plus WebFetch+pdftotext to directly read two primary sources (Pagano-Peng-Schwartz 2008 NASDAQ call-auction working paper; Baker-Greenwood-Wurgler JF page). Each topic gives operator-language translations of literature treatments tagged [Sx], followed by a 16-entry source table (title/authors/year-month/journal/link/verified) and a PI-facing summary separating solid evidence, inference-only (non-A-share) claims, and honestly-reported search gaps. One source (S16, China firm-age paper) is marked verified:false because author names could not be confirmed. Notably flagged that L3's literature analogy (deviation beats level, from volume/turnover studies) is directly contradicted by this round's own in-sample result for day_centroid, so the real measurement should take priority over the indirect citation.
